authors: A. H. Land; A. G. Doig
title: An Automatic Method of Solving Discrete Programming Problems
verification: University-hosted original paper PDF downloaded; bibliographic page and sections 1–3 inspected. Entire proof and both examples have not been fully checked.
relation: Discrete decisions and valid bounds motivate exact-reference methods; our implementation uses binary edge inclusion and a connectivity upper bound, not the paper’s original LP-variable branching procedure.

authors: E. L. Lawler; D. E. Wood
title: Branch-and-Bound Methods: A Survey
verification: Publisher bibliographic record and abstract inspected; full paper was not accessible through the PDF link.
relation: Survey discusses constrained-optimization branch-and-bound and computational/storage tradeoffs. Our experiment measures search evaluations, bound calls, time and RSS; it is not a reproduction of the survey’s examples.
